title: TrueOpen Wire Reviewed Breaking Declaration V1
description: The committed authorization for a breaking release. tools/reviewed-breaking checks buf breaking's findings against this file and requires an exact match in both directions: an undeclared finding fails the build, and a declared finding that no longer occurs fails it too. Scoped to one protocol_version and one baseline so that no later release inherits the approval.

path.comment: Proto file the finding was reported against, relative to the buf module root. Empty for a module-level finding.

type.comment: buf breaking rule id, e.g. FIELD_NO_DELETE.

message.comment: buf's own text. It carries the specifics a reviewer checks; line and column are deliberately not part of a finding's identity.
